posting.title: Graduate Data Scientist (Entry Level)
posting.description:
About the role:
Fjordwave Insights runs a two-year graduate programme for people starting their career in data science. We are looking for a recent graduate to join our data team on a rotational basis.

Responsibilities:
You will assist senior data scientists with building and maintaining ML pipelines, write SQL queries against our data warehouse, and help process data on AWS and Spark under close supervision.

Requirements:
0-1 years of professional experience is expected — this is an entry-level, rotational graduate programme, not a leadership position, and you will report to a senior data scientist throughout. Familiarity with Python (scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas) and SQL from your studies is required. Exposure to AWS and Spark is a plus but will be taught on the job.

Location and work mode:
Hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, three days a week on-site.

What we offer:
A structured onboarding programme, a dedicated mentor, and a clear path to a permanent data scientist role after the programme.
